_help: Display names and exclusions for the Credit Consumption Report.
Nothing here changes the database: the report maps names as it reads them.
Keys under 'rename' match case-insensitively and ignore surrounding spaces.
A client renamed to null is shown as 'No client' (a placeholder, not a real client).
Clients listed under 'internal' are our own work, shown apart from client work on the Summary.
Accounts under 'exclude' are left out of the management view (and of the full report when
'Exclude test & admin accounts' is on); admins are always excluded with them.

accounts._help: Optional labels for tool accounts, by account id, e.g. {"288": "Design team"}.

_help: billing: account id -> 'monthly' (default) or 'annual' (the fee is then a yearly fee).
billing_unconfirmed: account ids whose fee frequency is being checked (counted as monthly, flagged).
confirmed_billed: account ids whose renewal date has passed but which are confirmed still billed;
until listed here, such an account's unused fee is left out of the totals and shown under 'To confirm'.
untracked_ai_tools: AI tools paid for whose usage the dashboard does not capture (tool names as in IT Tools);
their fees appear as one Summary line, outside cost per item.
